Mia: Pushed a steady-burst bench for mosaic-7b (q8x4) across three regions. short/long mix 50/50, sim QPS shape from prod. results below, pls quick review.

Mia: TL;DR — H100 consistently higher tokens/sec and lower $/1M tokens in US/EU for this workload. A100 still competitive in Asia due to cheaper SKU availability and slightly better quantized-quality for long answers.

Mia: run command used:
```
./bench --model mosaic-7b --quant q8x4 --gpu ${GPU} --kernel flash_attn2 --workload workloads/steadyburst.json --seq-prefill 512 --seq-decode 128 --batching continuous
```

deploy-bot: job 2026-03-19T17:01: finished, artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/bench/2829991111

Sam: can you paste the metric table? numbers only plz.

Mia: pasted raw lines from the runner:
us-east1 (H100): tokens/sec 21,300 | prefill p50 12ms p95 42ms p99 95ms | decode p50 8ms p95 35ms p99 88ms | $/1M tokens $5.70
us-east1 (A100): tokens/sec 14,800 | prefill p50 20ms p95 68ms p99 170ms | decode p50 12ms p95 58ms p99 210ms | $/1M tokens $8.90

europe-west1 (H100): tokens/sec 19,800 | prefill p50 14ms p95 51ms p99 115ms | decode p50 9ms p95 38ms p99 95ms | $/1M tokens $5.20
europe-west1 (A100): tokens/sec 13,900 | prefill p50 22ms p95 75ms p99 180ms | decode p50 13ms p95 62ms p99 220ms | $/1M tokens $8.30

asia-east1 (H100): tokens/sec 17,200 | prefill p50 16ms p95 62ms p99 140ms | decode p50 11ms p95 70ms p99 260ms | $/1M tokens $7.40
asia-east1 (A100): tokens/sec 16,100 | prefill p50 18ms p95 70ms p99 160ms | decode p50 10ms p95 56ms p99 200ms | $/1M tokens $6.80

Elena: quick quality note — we ran evalset-long (300 examples long-form). q8x4 vs fp16:
q8x4 rouge-2 drop ~0.6 on average (long answers), rouge-2 std dev 0.3. fp16 baseline had more coherent long scaffolding. small but noticeable.

Raj: interesting asia numbers — A100 cheaper $/1M there vs H100. is that pre or post-burstable pricing? iirc asia uses reserved skew.

Mia: yes asia H100 SKU is on-demand pricier in our config; the job used on-demand pricing. will re-run with reserved (we've got capacity) to check.

Sam: which kernel was chosen? flash_attn2 or fallback/triton? kernel impacts p95 a lot.

Mia: bench picked flash_attn2 for H100, triton-legacy for A100 (because flash kernel build failed on that SKU in region). here's the selector snippet:
```
if gpu == 'h100': kernel='flash_attn2'
else: kernel='triton_legacy'
```

Mia: note: A100 fallback to triton caused worse p95 due to non-optimized KV concat path. adding to ops notes.

Elena: on q8x4 quality — small regression for long answers. could be mitigated with targeted mixed-precision (q4f16 on attention) or small prompt tuning. open to experiment.

Raj: suggestion: for eu-west promote H100 for production burst pools, leave A100 cold pool in asia and retest after building H100 flash kernel for that zone.

Mia: agreed. action items:

- Sam: validate cost model (inc. reserved SKUs) and update $/1M tokens calc (ETA 24h)
- Elena: run q4f16 sample for 1000 long-form evals and compare quality metrics (ETA 72h)
